tasks.short: Conduct engineering research and publish findings.

steps.what: Develop the engineering research question, experimental method and validation criteria
Conduct engineering experiments or simulations and investigate unexpected results
Analyze engineering research data and test physical explanations against uncertainty
Write research findings for professional journals, books or electronic media
Verify the complete research manuscript and approve the submission package
Submit the approved research findings through the journal or publication portal

tasks.design: Use validated analysis recipes in the scientific-analysis category of {OTHER} and linked figures and references in {DOCS}. Keep research choices, physical interpretation and substantive writing human, with a final gate on the actual publication submission.
tasks.previous_blocker: Similar experiments repeat data preparation, figure generation and manuscript reference handling.
tasks.enabler_now: Native analysis projects and linked figures can reuse established calculations and formatting.
tasks.still_hard: A reproducible calculation may rest on the wrong physical assumptions or an invalid experiment.
tasks.human_edge: Design discriminating tests and explain uncertainty without overstating a result.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated analysis preparation and manuscript mechanics; research authorship is unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: scientific analysis tools support reusable calculation projects and figure outputs, while document tools can link figures and references; these do not replace scientific interpretation.

assumptions: Boundary includes this teacher's research and written publication submission; publisher review and coauthor labour are outside the denominator. Shares are provisional. Instrument and simulation runtime receive no human saving.

s2 produces observed values, units, calibration or model revision, run conditions and uncertainty notes within unchanged research time. s3 manually validates fields and applies only previously validated calculations; unusual data retain manual analysis.

s3 saves repeated preparation and figure mechanics only. s4 saves figure and citation copying, not reasoning or substantive prose. Test native scientific recipes and reference links before custom code; no data or citations are invented.

{OTHER} includes scientific tools, reference manager and publication portal. s5 checks the complete final files and actual authorship permissions; s6 remains a manual external submission. Any required coauthor agreement must already exist for that exact version; otherwise submission stops.
research_questions: Can saved analysis preparation be separated from unchanged scientific reasoning in actual research sessions?

already_counted.description: Validate final manuscript and publication package

incremental.description: Maintain calculation validation cases and figure-source links

approvals.approved_version: Complete manuscript, figures, references and destination approved in s5 with required author permissions; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes six repeated-analysis-preparation and five manuscript-mechanics hours less two upkeep. Low assumes bespoke analysis and already linked figures, leaving upkeep only. Experimental work, interpretation and submission retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare engineering syllabi, homework and handouts.

steps.what: Choose course coverage, sequence and engineering learning outcomes for the materials
Develop engineering homework problems, worked solutions and explanatory handout content
Prepare syllabi, homework assignments and handouts in the course document templates
Check equations, units, solutions, dates and accessibility and approve finished course materials
Release approved syllabi, homework and handouts to the enrolled students

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} course templates and {LMS} reusable material blocks. Assemble only teacher-verified engineering content, preserve full equation and solution checks, and release the complete approved revision to students.
tasks.previous_blocker: Course packs repeat calendars, document structure, equation placement and content assembly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates and reusable blocks can carry verified content into consistent course materials.
tasks.still_hard: A plausible-looking problem may be underdetermined, unsafe or dimensionally wrong.
tasks.human_edge: Choose meaningful engineering problems and verify that students can solve them from the given information.
tasks.altitude: Less document assembly; problem design and academic responsibility stay human.

reach.task: Align engineering assignments with learning outcomes

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: document and learning-system templates can reuse course structure and approved content without generating engineering solutions.

assumptions: Boundary includes syllabi, assignments, handouts, checks and student release. Shares are provisional and assume repeated course-pack assembly, not wholly new content every time.

Academic administration supplies the timetable; s1 verifies course identifiers, dates and coverage. s2 writes the exact problem statements, values, units, diagrams and worked solutions using scientific-calculation tools in {OTHER}; all intellectual design time remains.

s3 manually selects and maps final content into native blocks. It saves repetitive assembly and formatting only; no new structured content capture is uncounted. s4 checks actual rendered outputs and independently works solutions where needed.
Test existing templates first. Student versions exclude answer keys unless expressly selected. A changed equation, deadline, answer-key inclusion or cohort invalidates release approval.
research_questions: Do reusable blocks preserve equations and answer-key separation across accessible student formats?

already_counted.description: Check final engineering content and approve student release

incremental.description: Maintain templates and equation-rendering regression examples

approvals.approved_version: Exact student material files, answer-key exclusions, deadlines and cohort approved in s4; edits void release approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes 18 assembly and five release hours less two upkeep. Low assumes existing templates already cover assembly, leaving release only. Content design and technical checks retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate and grade engineering students' work.

steps.what: Retrieve engineering students' submissions and applicable marking criteria
Check closed numerical answers and fixed-format results against the verified answer key
Evaluate and grade laboratory work, assignments and papers for engineering reasoning and method
Write feedback explaining engineering errors and useful corrections
Approve final grades and feedback after checking units, methods and student identities
Record approved engineering grades in the official student results system
Release the approved engineering grades and feedback privately to students

tasks.design: Configure native closed-answer marking and comment banks in {LMS}, with examiner-set numerical tolerances. Keep engineering method and partial-credit judgement human, then gate official grade recording and private student release separately.
tasks.previous_blocker: Closed-answer checking, recurring feedback text and results re-entry repeat between assessments.
tasks.enabler_now: Native answer keys, rubric comments and approved-grade transfer can handle those bounded mechanics.
tasks.still_hard: The right numerical result can come from a wrong method, and alternative methods can be valid.
tasks.human_edge: Evaluate assumptions, units, engineering reasoning and fair partial credit.
tasks.altitude: Less closed-answer checking and duplicate entry; examiner judgement remains intact.

evidence.claim: Ans supports automated marking of closed questions; this supports fixed-answer checking, not open engineering-method assessment.

assumptions: Boundary includes mixed engineering assessment through official recording and private release. Shares are provisional for a workload with some closed numerical items; open-only courses have less saving.

Students supply answers with identity, assignment and attempt IDs. The examiner supplies a previously verified key with expected values, units, tolerances and score rules as part of assessment design; s2 checks key applicability and ambiguous answers in retained time.

s3 retains all open reasoning and partial-credit decisions; s4 saves only insertion of recurring factual comments and manually writes tailored feedback. No model evaluates engineering reasoning. Test native marking and transfer before custom integration.

{OTHER} includes the assessment engine and official student-results system. s5 checks the complete final mark-feedback mapping; missing identities block s6 and s7. Changes void both exact-version approvals, and release follows successful recording.
research_questions: Do configured tolerances handle valid answers without concealing method errors or unit mistakes?

incremental.description: Maintain answer-key tests and results-transfer mappings

approvals.approved_version: Final student-assignment-attempt-grade mapping approved in s5; edits void recording approval
Final marks, feedback and private student recipients approved in s5; changes void release approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes five retrieval, 12 closed-answer checking, three recurring-feedback and ten recording/release hours less two upkeep. Low assumes existing retrieval, marking, comments and transfer leave only release. Open engineering reasoning keeps full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write proposals for external engineering research funding.

steps.what: Read the funding call and confirm engineering research eligibility and required sections
Design the engineering research work packages, methods, milestones and partner commitments
Calculate grant costs from research effort, equipment and eligible cost rules
Write the external research grant proposal and supporting narrative

loop.purpose: Draft proposal prose from the researcher's actual plan and verified facts
loop.input: Call revision, research plan, calculated budget and verified institutional facts
loop.output: Sectioned proposal draft with source links and flagged gaps
loop.check: Researcher verifies every technical claim, deliverable, resource commitment and impact statement against the plan and call; no unsupported results or partnerships remain
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unresolved claims or funder restrictions require manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native forms reuse administrative facts, but variable technical narrative needs prose drafting

steps.what: Approve the complete technical proposal, budget and supporting attachments
Authorize the final grant package and institutional financial commitments
Submit the authorized engineering research grant package through the funder portal

tasks.design: Use the native budget workbook in {SPREADSHEET} and existing institutional facts in {DOCS}, then a bounded proposal-drafting loop. The researcher reviews the finished technical package and an institutional authorizer approves its actual commitments before manual funder-portal submission.
tasks.previous_blocker: Budget formulas and proposal phrasing are repeated alongside original research design.
tasks.enabler_now: Reusable budget rules and constrained prose drafting can reduce mechanics without inventing scientific merit.
tasks.still_hard: A persuasive proposal must be feasible, original and honest about uncertain outcomes.
tasks.human_edge: Design the research and stand behind scientific and institutional commitments.
tasks.altitude: Less budget arithmetic and first-draft phrasing; funding and commitment authority remain unchanged.

reach.task: Plan education and dissemination linked to research

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: verified budget formulas and constrained drafting can support grant preparation; they do not establish research feasibility or funder acceptance.

assumptions: Boundary includes proposal preparation and submission. Other-role institutional authorization is ten of 100 workflow hours and excluded from the focal baseline of 90. Shares are provisional; grant success is not a saving.

Researcher s2 records real work packages, effort, milestones and partner commitments. Finance supplies approved rates and cost eligibility data; s3 manually maps these and checks equipment estimates in retained time. Existing facts supply institution ID and verified credentials; missing facts are flagged, not invented.

Test native funder forms and institutional proposal templates before a loop. s4 includes claim-by-claim review and correction. The loop is disabled wherever the call or confidentiality rules prohibit it, and existing confidential third-party proposals are never supplied.

{OTHER} is the funder portal. s5 and s6 approve the complete assembled files and budget after they exist. Any authorizer change returns to s5 and then s6. s7 submits only that exact package and adds no automated external authority.
research_questions: Does reviewed drafting save time after technical claim checks and call-specific restrictions?

incremental.description: Maintain budget-rule validation and proposal source checks

approvals.approved_version: Same complete package, institutional commitments and funder destination approved in s6; changes require both approvals again

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central net is 12 saved focal workflow hours divided by 90, less three upkeep, about 10.33%. Six arithmetic and six drafting hours change. Low assumes existing formulas and no permitted drafting assistance, leaving upkeep only. Research design, reviews, other-role authorization and submission stay unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use native engineering calculation and teaching systems around research and educational judgement.
role.ambitious_version: Reduce repeated preparation while keeping scientific, assessment and institutional commitments explicit.
